Better get a head start on this before everything gets chaotic.
Before her long to-do list can take over, Isla opens up the grid to start the day.

No point in stressing over a train delay I can't even control.
When her train falls behind schedule, she chooses to focus on the puzzle instead of stressing.

Just three minutes to breathe and focus. No rushing.
Sitting quietly at the cafe, she flips her phone over and claims a few silent minutes.

Check the daily rule before trusting it.
The daily rule changes the move, so Isla checks it before trusting the answer.

Perfect, that actually fits nicely.
With the constraint carefully met, her solution locks in and the rest of the day feels easier.

Alright, that's enough for now. Time to move on.
After one final look, she closes her laptop to keep the frantic rushing from creeping back.
